subject: Hosted API renewal and tier harmonization - NorthBridge
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@northbridge.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API renewal and tier harmonization - NorthBridge

Hi Alyssa,

Hope you’re well — we’re coming up on your renewal and I wanted to start the conversation early so we can line up the right commit and SLAs for NorthBridge’s increased usage this year. From what we’ve observed over the last quarter your hosted token volume has been trending +65% month-over-month and your peak windows are lengthening.

Options we can propose:
- Move to a higher monthly committed tier (suggested: 1.25M tokens/mo -> 2.5M tokens/mo) with stepped rate bands to smooth unit pricing.
- Add a soft-burst window (30% burst above commit for short periods) to avoid throttling during spikes.
- 12-month term with an early-upgrade credit to apply if you accelerate usage mid-term.

I’ve attached a short SOW snapshot that outlines current usage and a rough pricing scaffold. Can we lock 30 minutes early next week to go over pricing and any procurement requirements? Priyom is cc’d to help model the economics.

Thanks,
--
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: NorthBridge_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf, 240KB)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@northbridge.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:03:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal and tier harmonization - NorthBridge

Hi David — thanks for the heads up and for the SOW. We’ve definitely been ramping faster than expected; the engineering team pushed a new feature in late April that doubled our inference calls.

A few asks from our side:
1) Can you provide a committed-tier option that reduces per-token price at ~2.5M and 5M monthly buckets, with sample monthly invoices?
2) We need clarity on the soft-burst definition (granularity, how often it applies) and whether there are automatic throttles after sustained bursts.
3) Procurement will require a single-page amendment for the term and pricing; they don’t want major legal changes. I’ve cc’d procurement as requested.

We’re open to a 12-month renewal if the financials make sense; preferred start date: 2028-07-01. Happy to take a 30-minute call Monday or Tuesday.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Product, NorthBridge Tech
alyssa.chen@northbridge.com
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API renewal and tier harmonization - NorthBridge (internal pricing ask)

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Alyssa’s responses. Key asks: two committed tiers (2.5M, 5M), clear soft-burst behavior, and a lightweight amendment for procurement. Start target 2028-07-01.

My recommendation:
- Offer tier A: 2.5M tokens/mo @ $0.0016/token (monthly), tier B: 5M tokens/mo @ $0.0014/token.
- Soft-burst: +30% sustained for up to 6 hours/day or 72 hours/month before soft-throttle; any sustained overages billed at an overage cap rate (negotiated) to avoid surprise.
- Include a one-time early-upgrade credit equal to 25% of the difference for the first invoice if they move to a higher commit in the first 90 days.

Marissa — can we approve a 10% logo discount for a 12-month commit? Priyom — can you run a quick math model showing expected ARR and per-token blended cost across their current monthly run rate vs the proposed tiers?

Thanks — I’ll propose a 30-minute slot Monday 10:00am PT unless I hear otherwise.
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@northbridge.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed amendment & pricing options (DocuSign)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the quick reply and for looping procurement. Per our internal alignment attached are two formal pricing options plus a short amendment intended to slot onto your existing order form:

- Option 1: 12-month, 2.5M tokens/mo commit @ $0.0016/token, soft-burst +30% (policy: 6 hours/day or 72 hours/month before soft-throttle), 10% logo discount applied to committed spend.
- Option 2: 12-month, 5M tokens/mo commit @ $0.0014/token, soft-burst +30% (same policy), 12% logo discount + 25% early-upgrade credit if upgraded within first 90 days.

Attached: redwood_renewal_amendment_v1.docx (Word doc with amendment language) and a one-page compare PDF. I’ve also created a DocuSign envelope so procurement can sign the amendment quickly: https://app.docusign.com/alias/1234-ABCD-NB-2028

If procurement wants smaller legal changes we can accept limited deviation language (no changes to core SLAs or data policies). Please let us know which option you prefer and we’ll route the DocuSign.

Best,
Alyssa
